title: Renewals
intro: We handle all your business renewals in one place. Stay compliant and avoid penalties with our hassle-free service.
body: If you have added these services in the past and still wish to continue, do it manually with a click of a button. Renewal of services helps in extending your services to keep it active. In case you find any of your services being expired without your knowledge, Please check your online manager section to find things under expired services or you can call us at **[+44 7360 515317](https://wa.me/447360515317?text=I%20want%20Information%20About%20Renewals%20Service).**
**Manually renew your services here, at any time**

If you wish to renew a service, select the Buy Now button and login into your account, after which you will be taken to your Active Services page, where you will be able to extend the service (and any other services you may have), for another year.

**Renew services that have expired:** If the service you wish to renew has expired within the last 35 days, select the Services tab on the menu and then select Renew Expired Services. Services that expired over 35 days ago, cannot be renewed and require being re-purchased.

**Renew your address services :** Renew your Registered Office Address and continue to protect the privacy of your home address for another 12 months.Additionally, maintain the privacy provided with our Service Address for another year.

For clients who wish to add or remove directors, our team of professionals provides services that includes the filing of Companies House papers and all other paperwork required to keep your business records current and compliant.
Protect the privacy of your home and enhance your corporate image with our prestigious London registered office address, with all official government mail scanned and emailed to you, free of charge.
